summary: Liberty Media filed an 8-K disclosing a November 4, 2026 Exchange Agreement with John C. Malone and related entities. The Malone Holders surrendered 2,316,537 Series B common shares (cancelled and retired) for 602,302 Series A and 5,420,699 Series C shares, plus 12,298 Series A and 63,378 Series C adjustment shares issued to Malone's revocable trust related to 47,297 exchangeable Series C shares it retained. A disinterested special committee of independent directors, advised by separate financial and legal counsel, approved the transaction, which closed concurrently with signing; no price, premium or outside close date was stated. Watch for recapitalization effects on the Series B/C overhang and Malone's aggregate voting position.
